title: BetaClaudeTagSlackWorkspaceBundleTarget
description: One Bundle attached to one Slack workspace. The Bundle can be used in the workspace and in every channel in it.

id.description: The Bundle Target's identifier. Starts with `btgt_`. No two Bundle Targets have the same one, and the same Bundle and target always give the same one, also after a detach and a new attach. It is opaque.

slack_workspace_id.description: The identifier of the Slack workspace the Bundle is attached to, starting with `slws_`.
